H5_ARMORED_H5C.description:
{Unbreakable Armor}
Immune to all spells and effects that lower Defense.

H5_PRECISE_SHOT_H5C.description:
{Precise Shot}
Ignores target Defense when shooting at targets less than ${val} hexes away.

H5_HOLD_GROUND_H5C.description:
{Hold Ground}

H5_ELDRITCH_AURA_H5C.description:
{Spell Deflection}

H5_ELEMENTAL_H5C.description:
{Elemental}
Non-living: immune to poison, blindness and Mind spells; cannot be healed or resurrected.

H5_DEMON_RAGED_H5C.description:
{Blood Fury}
Builds rage when fighting under a hero with the Blood Rage skill: melee +100, shooting +50, casting on enemies +40, own stack lost +30 (+60 with Enrage), enemy stack lost +20, hit by a harmful spell +10; defend -30, wait -100, dazed or intimidated -20/-100. 200/500/1000 points unlock levels 1/2/3 (Basic/Advanced/Expert Blood Rage each open one level). Rage also absorbs part of the damage taken.

H5_WEAKENED_SHOW_H5C.description:
{Weakening Strike}

H5_AGILITY_SHOW_H5C.description:

H5_FRIGHTENED_H5C.description:
{Fear}

H5_GATING_H5C.description:
{Hell Gate}
With at least 4 stacks of H5 demons on your side (not counting summons and clones), demons your hero brings in with Gating become their H5 counterparts in the same number, basic to basic and upgraded to upgraded; Gogs and Efreet, which H5 lacks, become Horned Demons and Pit Fiends of the same tier.

H5_NECRO_RAISE_H5C.description:
{H5 Necromancy}
If the hero's army has at least 4 stacks of H5 undead (stacks present at battle start, not counting summons and clones), Necromancy after this victory raises H5 creatures instead: Skeletons become H5 Skeletons; Walking Dead, Ghosts, Vampires, Liches, Black Knights, Bone Dragons and others unlocked by skills, artifacts or specialties become H5 units of the same tier and form (upgrades to the first upgrade, third forms to third forms). The number raised uses the normal formula, scaled by the new unit's Hit Points. Raise targets from other mods (Undead Valley, Crypt units and so on) are unchanged.
